description: This file defines the Notification class used for in-app notifications within a backend API. It models notification properties such as userId, type, message, read status, and creation timestamp, with persistence annotations for MongoDB.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Entity class representing in-app notifications sent to users, with fields for identification, message details, and status.

methods.name: Notification
methods.description: Parameterized constructor for initializing Notification with userId, type, and message.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user identifier associated with this notification.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the notification type (INFO, ALERT, WARNING).

methods.name: isRead
methods.description: Returns whether the notification has been read.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the notification was created.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user identifier for the notification.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets the message content of the notification.

methods.name: setRead
methods.description: Marks the notification as read or unread.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the notification.
